function.name: send_image
function.description: Sends a previously downloaded image to the user as a photo with an optional caption. Requires an image_id returned by download_image.

image_id.description: Exact image_id returned by download_image. It expires after about 10 minutes; if it is missing, call download_image again.

caption.description: Optional photo caption shown under the image, max 1024 characters.
